cases.situation: Plumber was booked for 8am to fix our leaking water heater. I took the morning off, it's 10 now and nobody showed or called. The company is Pellow & Sons Plumbing, the scheduler was Tina.
cases.reply: Hi Tina, Pellow & Sons were booked for 8am today to repair our water heater, and nobody arrived or called. I took the morning off for this. Can you confirm a new time by end of day tomorrow? If I don't hear back by then, I'll book another plumber.
cases.note: Factual and dated, with the consequence stated once, not threatened.

cases.situation: 闺蜜最近三次约饭都是当天下午才说来不了，这周六又约了看展。我不想闹僵，但真的有点累了。
cases.reply: 我很喜欢跟你出来玩，但最近三次约好的饭都是当天取消的，我这边就有点不敢提前安排了。不是生气，就是想找个对你更轻松的方式。周六要不改成下午在你家附近喝杯咖啡？或者你说说什么安排更适合你。
cases.note: 用"三次"而不是"你总是"，对方就没法争论；说的是你会怎么调整，不是给她下通牒。

cases.situation: I completely forgot a 9am discovery call with a potential client, Amanda, who runs a group of dental clinics and wants her online booking page redone. She just emailed 'Did I have the wrong time?' I'm a freelance web designer, free Thursday at 9 or Friday at 1.
cases.reply: Hi Amanda, you had the right time. I missed our 9am call and I'm sorry, you set aside the start of your morning and I wasn't there. Could we do Thursday at 9 or Friday at 1? I'll bring a first-pass review of your online booking page so the time is well spent.
cases.note: Take the blame off her first, then offer two slots so she doesn't do the rescheduling work.

cases.situation: I'm a private math tutor. A parent, Mrs. Alvarez, cancelled her son Mateo's session 2 hours before the start, second time this month. My policy, which she signed, is 24 hours' notice or the full $60 is charged. I have Thursday at 5pm or Saturday at 10am open this week. She just texted that charging for a cancellation is ridiculous.
cases.reply: Hi Mrs. Alvarez, I understand it's frustrating. The 24-hour policy is in the agreement you signed, and I apply it to every family, so today's $60 charge stands. I'd like to keep Mateo's momentum going: I have Thursday at 5pm or Saturday at 10am open this week. Which suits you better?
cases.note: When a client argues the fee: restate the policy once, apply it evenly, and move straight to rebooking. Waiving it for the loudest parent teaches everyone else.

cases.situation: 朋友介绍的相亲，约了今晚7点在一家叫山海小馆的餐厅见面。现在7点25了，对方还没到，也没发消息。我不想显得很生气，也不想一直干等。
cases.reply: 你好，我已经到山海小馆了，坐在靠窗的位置。路上还顺利吧？我等到7点45，要是今天赶不过来也没关系，我们改天再约。
cases.note: 第一次见面、偶尔一次：先往好处想，说清你等到几点，再留一个轻松改约的台阶。

cases.situation: I'm meeting a new client, Victor, at his office at 2pm for a project kickoff. The Jubilee line is suspended and I'll be about 20 minutes late. It's 1:40 now.
cases.reply: Hi Victor, the Jubilee line is suspended and I'm going to be about 20 minutes late, so around 2:20. Sorry to eat into your afternoon. If that squeezes you, I can do the kickoff by phone at 2 instead and we meet in person next week. Whichever is easier for you.
cases.note: Warn before the start time, not after, with a real ETA and an option that protects their schedule.

cases.situation: Mon amie Claire arrive toujours avec 30 à 40 minutes de retard. On a réservé un resto vendredi 2 octobre à 20h. Je ne veux pas me fâcher, mais je ne veux plus attendre seule devant une carafe d'eau.
cases.reply: J'ai réservé pour vendredi à 20h ! Je te préviens gentiment : à 20h15 je commande, que tu sois là ou pas, comme ça je ne reste pas devant une assiette vide. Hâte de te voir !
cases.note: Dire ce que tu vas faire, pas ce qu'elle doit faire, et le dire avant le dîner plutôt qu'après 40 minutes d'attente.

cases.situation: In August I told my friend Megan her last-minute cancelling was getting to me, and we agreed to try short weekday coffees. She's cancelled two of those since, the latest an hour before today's. I'm done booking ahead with her, but I don't want to end the friendship.
cases.reply: No stress at all, hope everything's okay. I'm going to stop booking things in advance for now, it's easier on both of us. But if you're ever free last minute, text me and I'll come if I can.
cases.note: After naming the pattern once, you change how you plan, not the friendship. Say it once, without heat, and don't list the cancellations again.

cases.situation: Sou personal trainer. O Felipe, aluno novo, tinha treino comigo hoje às 7h no Parque da Cidade e não apareceu nem avisou. Esperei até 7h30. Nosso contrato diz que falta sem aviso de 12 horas é cobrada, mas foi a primeira vez. Posso remarcar para quinta, 1º de outubro, às 7h.
cases.reply: Oi, Felipe, tudo bem? Tínhamos treino hoje às 7h no Parque da Cidade e te esperei até 7h30. Se aconteceu alguma coisa, sem problema. Posso te encaixar na quinta, 1º de outubro, às 7h, no mesmo lugar. Só lembrando que, pelo nosso contrato, falta sem aviso de 12 horas é cobrada normalmente a partir da próxima.
cases.note: Falta profissional: fato com horário, uma opção concreta para remarcar e a regra para a próxima vez, dita uma vez e sem ameaça.

cases.situation: I was supposed to meet my sister Nadia at Central station on Sunday to help with her two suitcases after her trip. I overslept, she waited 40 minutes and ended up paying €35 for a taxi. I've just sent her the €35 and I'm free Friday evening, but I've been avoiding texting her because I feel terrible.
cases.reply: Nadia, I left you waiting at Central for 40 minutes on Sunday with two suitcases, and I'm really sorry. I overslept, which is no excuse. You gave up your time and paid for a taxi you shouldn't have needed, so I've just sent you the €35. Can I take you to dinner on Friday, my treat, and hear about the trip properly?
cases.note: When you're the no-show: name it with the specifics, own it without a 'but', cover their real cost, and put a dated fix on the table so she doesn't do the rescheduling.

cases.situation: I told my friend Sam that three of our last four plans got cancelled on the day and suggested weekday coffees near her office instead. She replied 'wow, didn't realise you were keeping a tally.' I don't want a fight, and I'm free Wednesday at 12:30.
cases.reply: I'm not keeping score to punish you, promise. I'd rather say it than quietly stop inviting you, because I like seeing you. Let's try the coffee idea: Wednesday at 12:30 near yours? If that doesn't suit, tell me what would.
cases.note: When they get defensive about the pattern, restate the intent once, don't argue the count, and move straight to a concrete plan.

cases.situation: 我是奶茶店店长。店员小李这两周9点开店的早班迟到了三次，9月17日、22日和今天，每次20分钟左右，开店时就我一个人手忙脚乱。他平时干活挺好的，想在微信上跟他说一下。
cases.reply: 小李，你平时干活我一直挺放心的。想跟你说个事：这两周早班迟到了三次，9月17日、22日和今天，每次20分钟左右，开店那会儿就我一个人顶着，实在忙不过来。以后早班请8点45前到，万一要迟到，提前半小时给我发个消息。如果9点的早班对你来说确实难赶，直接跟我说，我们看看排班能不能调。
cases.note: 对员工也是对人温和、对规律清楚：给具体日期，不说“老是”；讲清期待，再留一个可以商量的出口，不追问为什么。

cases.situation: I own a café, Hearth Coffee, and had an interview booked with a barista candidate, Jordan, yesterday at 3pm. I waited until 3:20 and he didn't show or message. His CV is strong and we're short-staffed, so I'm open to one more try, Friday 2 October at 10am.
cases.reply: Hi Jordan, we had your interview at Hearth Coffee booked for 3pm yesterday, and I waited until 3:20. Hope everything's okay. I'm still keen to talk, and I can do Friday 2 October at 10am. If that works, reply to confirm by tomorrow evening, and if you've taken another job, a quick note is completely fine too.
cases.note: One second chance, one slot, no lecture. If he misses this one too, move on without another message.

cases.situation: University group project, four of us, presenting on Thursday October 8. Our teammate Ravi missed both rehearsals this week, Monday and yesterday, without a message, and he has the market analysis slides. We need them in the shared deck by Saturday 3 October at 6pm for a full run-through on Monday. I want to message him directly, not in the group chat.
cases.reply: Hey Ravi, hope you're okay. You missed Monday's and yesterday's rehearsals without a message, and we still haven't seen the market analysis slides. We need them in the shared deck by Saturday 3 October at 6pm so we can run the full thing on Monday. If something's going on, tell me by tomorrow and we'll split it differently. If I haven't heard anything by Saturday, the rest of us will write that section ourselves so we're ready.
cases.note: Peer no-show: check they're okay, give a dated need, and say what you will do if you hear nothing, not what they must do.

cases.situation: 我在二手平台上卖一台婴儿车，买家约好今天下午3点来小区门口自提。我抱着孩子等到3点半，人没来，消息也没回。还有别人问过想要。明天10月1日上午10点我还能再等一次，想让他今晚9点前确认。
cases.reply: 你好，今天约的下午3点在小区门口提婴儿车，我等到3点半没见到你，也没收到消息，希望没出什么事。如果还想要，明天10月1日上午10点我可以再在门口等一次，麻烦今晚9点前回复确认。到时没收到回复，我就卖给其他问过的买家了。
cases.note: 陌生买家爽约：事实加时间，一个具体的改约时间和回复截止点，后果说一次，不指责。

cases.situation: 上周六（9月26日）上午10点约了摄影师阿杰在公园拍全家福，我们记错成周日，没去也没通知，他等了40分钟。合同写爽约不退300元定金。我想道歉并重新约，10月10日周六或10月11日周日上午都行，新定金今天就能转。
cases.reply: 阿杰你好，上周六上午10点的全家福是我们记错了日子，没去也没提前说，让你在公园白等了40分钟，真的很抱歉。合同写的300元定金不退，这个我们认，不用退。想重新约一次，10月10日周六或10月11日周日上午，你看哪天方便？新的定金我今天就转给你。
cases.note: 自己爽约服务方：说清是哪一次、承认对方的时间成本，主动接受合同里的后果，再给具体日期。

cases.situation: I was meant to collect my daughter Isla from her friend Maya's house at 5 yesterday. My meeting ran over, I only texted Maya's mum, Priya, at 5:30 and got there at 5:50, and she had to miss her gym class. I could have Maya over this Saturday afternoon, 3 October, and do the pickup and drop-off.
cases.reply: Priya, I was 50 minutes late picking Isla up yesterday and only texted at 5:30, and I'm sorry. My meeting ran over, but that's on me. You missed your gym class because of it. Could I have Maya over this Saturday, 3 October, for the afternoon, so you get a few free hours? I'll do the pickup and drop-off.
cases.note: You were the late one: name the minutes, own it without a 'but', acknowledge her cost and offer a dated make-good she doesn't have to organise.

cases.situation: Tengo un restaurante en Sevilla. Una reserva de 10 personas a nombre de Marta Gil para el sábado 26 de septiembre a las 21:00 no vino ni avisó; guardamos la mesa hasta las 21:30 y dijimos que no a otros clientes. Las condiciones que aceptó al reservar dicen que sin cancelar con 24 horas se cobran 15 € por persona a la tarjeta de garantía, y tengo mesa para 10 libre el sábado 10 de octubre a las 21:00.
cases.reply: Hola, Marta. Teníamos su reserva para 10 personas el sábado 26 de septiembre a las 21:00; guardamos la mesa hasta las 21:30 y tuvimos que decir que no a otros clientes, sin recibir aviso. Según las condiciones que aceptó al reservar, se aplica el cargo de 15 € por persona, 150 € en total, a la tarjeta de garantía. Si quiere volver a intentarlo, tengo mesa para 10 el sábado 10 de octubre a las 21:00. Para las próximas reservas de grupo, las mismas condiciones seguirán aplicándose.
cases.note: El cargo se dice como un hecho, no como amenaza; comprueba antes que las condiciones aceptadas lo cubren.

cases.situation: 离婚后儿子豆豆每周六上午10点由他爸爸接走过周末。最近三个周六，他分别是10点40、11点05和10点50才到，事先也没说，豆豆每次都趴在窗口等。我不想吵架，只想以后别这样。
cases.reply: 豆豆每周都很盼着跟你过周末。最近三个周六，你分别是10点40、11点05和10点50到的，事先也没说，他每次都趴在窗口等。以后如果10点15你还没到、也没消息，我就先带他去楼下公园玩，你到了给我打电话。10点要是对你来说太赶，你说一个能准时到的时间，我们就改成那个。
cases.note: 对前任也是对事不对人：用具体时间代替'你总是'，说你会怎么做，再让他定一个守得住的时间；这些话别当着孩子说。

cases.situation: I'm a manager and I completely missed my 2pm 1:1 today with Lin, who reports to me. I got pulled into a budget review and didn't message her, and last week she told me she was bringing her promotion case to this one. I'm free tomorrow, Thursday, at 10.
cases.reply: Lin, I missed our 2pm today and didn't let you know, and I'm sorry. I got pulled into the budget review and should have messaged you. I know you'd prepared your promotion case for it, and it deserves proper time. Can we do tomorrow, Thursday, at 10? I've blocked the hour and I'll protect it.
cases.note: When you're the senior one, the cost to them is bigger than it looks: name it, and make the new slot one you control.

cases.situation: 我和同事小赵拼车上班，我开车。这个月我接她已经迟到了三次，9月14日、22日和29日，每次十几分钟，昨天还害她错过了9点的部门例会。我想好好道歉，并从明天起提前15分钟出门，8点05分到她楼下。
cases.reply: 小赵，这个月我接你迟到了三次，14号、22号和昨天，昨天还害你错过了9点的例会，真的对不起。这不是运气不好，是我早上出门卡得太紧。从明天起我提前15分钟出门，8点05分到你楼下；要是哪天真赶不上，我8点前一定发消息给你，你直接打车，车费我出。
cases.note: 自己的迟到成了规律，就别只为这一次道歉：说出次数，再给一个能兑现的改法。

cases.situation: My daughter Ella has a 45-minute piano lesson with Mr Hughes every Thursday at 5pm, £30 a lesson. The last three, on 10, 17 and 24 September, started 15 to 20 minutes late but still ended at 5:45. Ella loves him and I don't want to switch teachers; I drop her off again tomorrow.
cases.reply: Hi Mr Hughes, Ella really enjoys her lessons with you. I wanted to mention that the last three Thursdays, 10, 17 and 24 September, her lesson started 15 to 20 minutes late but still finished at 5:45, so she's had about 25 to 30 minutes rather than 45. Could we either start at 5 or run on to the full 45 minutes? Happy to talk it through when I drop her off tomorrow.
cases.note: A paid pattern: dates and minutes, a choice of two fixes, no accusation.

cases.situation: I volunteer Saturday mornings at a dog rescue, 9am to noon. Last Saturday, Sept 26, I completely forgot my shift, and the coordinator, Bev, had to walk 12 dogs with only one other volunteer. I'll be there this Saturday at 9 as usual and could stay until 2 if that helps.
cases.reply: Hi Bev, I completely missed my 9am shift last Saturday, and I'm sorry. No excuse, it just went out of my head, and it left you walking 12 dogs with only one other pair of hands. I'll be there this Saturday at 9 as usual, and I can stay until 2 if a few extra hours would help.
cases.note: Unpaid doesn't mean optional: own it the same way you would with a friend or a boss.

cases.situation: I'm in Lisbon. Yesterday I had a video call booked with Mei Ling, a partner in Singapore, at 9am my time, 4pm hers. I mixed up the time zones, joined an hour late, and she'd already waited 20 minutes at the end of her day and left. I can do 9am Lisbon time on Tuesday 6 or Thursday 8 October.
cases.reply: Hi Mei Ling, I missed our call yesterday and I'm sorry. I got the time zones wrong and joined an hour late, after you'd waited 20 minutes at the end of your day. Could we try again on Tuesday 6 or Thursday 8 October, at 9am Lisbon, 4pm Singapore? I'll send the invite with both times on it, so we're looking at the same clock.
cases.note: Across time zones: own the mix-up in one clause, acknowledge her cost, and put both local times in every proposal from now on.

cases.situation: My friend Dan and I are seeing Harbour Lights tonight: doors at 7, band on at 8:30. Both tickets are in my app, which lets me transfer one to him. We said we'd meet outside the main entrance at 7:30, it's now 7:50, and he isn't answering.
cases.reply: Hey, all okay? I'm outside the main entrance. I'm going in at 8:15 so I don't miss the start, and I've just transferred your ticket to you, so you can scan in whenever you get here. Text me when you're inside and I'll come find you.
cases.note: Check they're okay, say what you'll do and when, and take the ticket out of the equation so being late doesn't cost them the gig.

cases.situation: I open the bike shop at 9 today and my manager, Corinne, is off. I overslept, it's 8:40 and I'll be there at 9:25 at the earliest. The only booking before then is Mr Adeyemi's wheel repair at 9:15, and his number is in the booking app.
cases.reply: Hi Corinne, I overslept and I'm going to be late opening the shop, my fault. I'll be there by 9:25. The only booking before then is Mr Adeyemi's wheel repair at 9:15, so I'm calling him now to let him know. Sorry for the hassle on your day off.
cases.note: Late to your own shift: tell your manager before the start time, own it in a few words, give a real ETA and say how you're covering the knock-on.

cases.situation: 上周六约好朋友阿琪早上8点在山脚一起爬山，她睡过头没来，电话也没接，我在山脚等了一个小时。今天她微信道歉，说想请我吃饭赔罪。这是她第一次放我鸽子，我这周六晚上有空。
cases.reply: 谢谢你专门来说，我收到了。那天在山脚等了一个小时，说不郁闷是假的，不过第一次嘛，说开了就好。吃饭我接受！这周六晚上怎么样？下次要是起不来，提前发个消息给我就行。
cases.note: 对方道歉时别只回“没事”：轻轻说出你的代价，接受弥补，再定一个具体时间。

cases.situation: I'm Sophie. My uni friend Hattie RSVP'd yes for herself and her boyfriend Tom to our wedding last Saturday, 26 September, and neither of them came or messaged; we'd paid £85 a head for their meals. She hasn't said anything since, and I'm hurt but also worried something happened.
cases.reply: Hattie, we missed you and Tom on Saturday, and I haven't heard from you since, so I wanted to check everything's okay. I'll be honest, it stung a bit to see your two seats empty with no word, which is why I'm asking rather than guessing. If something happened, I'd really like to know. Either way, I'd love to catch up properly; are you free for a coffee next week?
cases.note: A friend's no-show at a big event: check they're okay first, name the effect in one line, and leave the meal cost out of the first message. If she stays unreachable, check with Tom or a mutual friend that she's safe.

cases.situation: 我妈中风后卧床，身边离不开人，家政公司安排护工张阿姨每天早上8点到家照顾她。今天到9点半人还没来，电话也没人接，我只好请假赶回家。对接的是公司的王经理，我希望明天起能确定有人8点到。
cases.reply: 王经理您好，今天早上8点张阿姨没到，到9点半也联系不上，我妈卧床离不开人，我只好临时请假赶回家。请您今天下午5点前告诉我：明天早上8点能不能确定有人到，是张阿姨还是换人。以后护工如果来不了，请至少提前一小时通知我；如果再出现没人来也没通知的情况，我就需要考虑换一家公司了。
cases.note: 卧床老人不能干等：联系不上护工时先安排家人或邻居照看，老人情况有异常立刻打120。

cases.situation: I'm Priya Nair. I had a final-round interview yesterday, Wednesday, at 11am with Helen Ortiz, head of design at Fernway Studio, and I'd written it down for Thursday. I only realised this morning when I saw her email saying 'We missed you today.' I'm free any time on Friday 2 or Monday 5 October.
cases.reply: Dear Helen, I'm so sorry I missed our interview yesterday at 11. I wrote it down for Thursday by mistake, and that's entirely on me; you set aside time for it and I wasn't there. I'm still very keen on the role. If you're able to offer another slot, I'm free any time on Friday 2 or Monday 5 October, and I completely understand if that isn't possible. Best wishes, Priya Nair
cases.note: When you're the no-show in a hiring process: own the mistake in one clause, acknowledge their time, offer real availability and leave the decision with them.

cases.situation: 我每周三晚上组织同事打羽毛球，场地两小时120元，四个人AA每人30。老周9月16日、23日和30日都在群里报了名，到点没来也没说一声，我们三个只能轮着打，场地费也是三个人分的。他人挺好的，我想私聊跟他说：以后报了名、当天下午5点前没说不来的，30块场地费照常AA。
cases.reply: 老周，每周三打球有你一起挺热闹的，想跟你说个小事。9月16日、23日和30日你都报了名，到点没来也没消息，我们三个只能轮着打，场地费也是三个人分的。不是怪你，就是想定个简单的规矩：以后报了名，当天下午5点前说不来就没事，没说的话那30块场地费还是照常AA。要是最近周三晚上不好排，直接跟我说，哪周想来再报就行。
cases.note: 用具体日期代替“老是”，说清你以后怎么做，再给他一个轻松退出的选项；不追问为什么。

cases.situation: Our regular babysitter, Ella, is 16 and our neighbour's daughter. She was booked for 6:30 last night so my husband Sam and I could go to his work dinner, but she didn't show or reply, and I ended up staying home. This morning she texted 'omg so sorry I totally forgot'; she's been great with the kids for a year, and our next booking is Saturday 10 October at 7pm.
cases.reply: Hi Ella, thanks for messaging this morning, I appreciate it. Last night was a tricky one: with no word by 6:30, I ended up missing Sam's work dinner. You've been brilliant with the kids for a year and we'd love to keep you. From now on, could you send me a quick text the day before each booking to confirm? The next one is Saturday 10 October at 7pm, so a message on Friday would be perfect, and if I haven't heard by Friday evening I'll find cover for that night, no hard feelings.
cases.note: A young, apologetic first slip: name the cost once, keep her, and fix it with a small system rather than a lecture.

cases.situation: I'm Tom, and I'm meeting my girlfriend Aisha's parents for the first time at Sunday lunch at their house at 1pm. My train is delayed and I'll arrive around 1:40. Aisha is already there, and I have her mum Farida Rahman's number; it's 12:45 now.
cases.reply: Hi Mrs Rahman, it's Tom. My train is delayed, so I'll be about 40 minutes late and at your door around 1:40. I'm really sorry, especially for a first visit. Please don't hold lunch for me, and I'll text again if anything changes.
cases.note: Warn before the start time, give a real arrival time and release them from waiting; one apology is enough, save the rest for in person.

cases.situation: I run a monthly coding meetup. Darren, a volunteer speaker, was booked to give a 20-minute talk on testing at 7pm last night; he didn't turn up or reply to my two texts, and we filled the slot with lightning talks. I'd still like him to speak, and the next meetup is Thursday 5 November at 7pm.
cases.reply: Hi Darren, we had you down for the testing talk at 7pm last night and didn't hear from you, so I hope everything's okay. We covered the slot with lightning talks. If you'd still like to give it, the next meetup is Thursday 5 November at 7pm and the slot is yours; could you let me know by Friday 23 October either way?
cases.note: A volunteer no-show: check they're okay, state the facts once without guilt, and offer one dated slot with a reply-by date; if he misses that too, stop booking him.

cases.situation: I organised a beach clean for our neighbourhood WhatsApp group on Saturday 26 September. Fourteen people signed up and five came; I'd borrowed 14 litter pickers from the Shoreline Friends charity, and the five of us filled 11 bags. The next one is Saturday 24 October at 10am, and I want people to take their name off the list if they can't come, without making anyone feel bad.
cases.reply: Huge thanks to the five who came on Saturday, we filled 11 bags between us! Fourteen signed up and five made it, so most of the borrowed litter pickers went back unused. For the next one, Saturday 24 October at 10am, one small change: if your plans shift, just take your name off the list by Thursday evening, no explanation needed. And anyone free on the day is still welcome to turn up.
cases.note: A group no-show: thank who came, state the numbers once without naming anyone, and fix it with an easy drop-out step rather than a scolding.

cases.situation: I'm a junior analyst, and Grace, a director in another team, agreed in August to mentor me with a 30-minute call once a month. Today's call was at 3pm and she didn't join or message; I know she's swamped with the year-end audit. I want to rebook without making her feel bad, and I'm free any lunchtime next week.
cases.reply: Hi Grace, we had our call at 3pm today and I didn't see you join, so I hope all's okay; I know the year-end audit is full on. Would any lunchtime next week work for 30 minutes? If the next few weeks are too packed, I'm very happy to pick it up once the audit's done, just say.
cases.note: When someone senior doing you a favour misses a slot: no guilt, an easy rebooking and an open offer to pause.

cases.situation: My friend Kenji offered to drive me to the airport this morning: pickup at 5am, and my flight is at 7:40. It's 5:15, he isn't here and isn't answering his phone. If he's not here by 5:25 I'll book a taxi on the app.
cases.reply: Hey Kenji, all okay? I'm outside with my bag. If I haven't heard from you by 5:25 I'll grab a taxi so I don't miss the flight, so no need to rush if you've overslept. Text me when you see this.
cases.note: With a hard deadline, set your cut-off early and say it out loud; the backup takes the pressure off both of you. If he's still unreachable later in the morning, check on him through someone he lives with or nearby.

cases.situation: 上周六是好朋友小雨的婚礼，我是伴娘，说好早上6点到她家帮忙接亲。结果闹钟没响，我7点20才到，堵门差点没人，她妈妈临时叫了表妹顶上。我想认真道个歉，下周五晚上或周日中午我都有空，想请她和新郎吃顿饭。
cases.reply: 小雨，上周六接亲我迟到了一个多小时，说好6点到，7点20才进门，真的对不起。闹钟没响不是理由，是我自己没多定一个。那天你们本来就忙，还害阿姨临时去叫表妹顶上堵门，给你们添了好多乱。下周五晚上或者周日中午，我请你和新郎吃顿饭好不好？你挑一个时间就行。
cases.note: 迟到的是自己：说清迟了多久、对方因此多做了什么，不找借口，再给两个具体时间的弥补，不让对方费心安排。

cases.situation: オンラインの言語交換で知り合ったスペイン在住のルシアさんと、毎週火曜の夜8時（日本時間）にビデオ通話で日本語とスペイン語を練習しています。今夜は8時半まで待っても彼女が入ってこず、メッセージもありません。まだ3回目で、来週の火曜も同じ時間なら空いています。
cases.reply: ルシアさん、こんばんは。大丈夫ですか？今夜は8時半まで通話で待っていましたが、今日はここで終わりにしますね。来週の火曜、同じ日本時間の夜8時でよければ、またお話ししましょう。都合が変わったら、気軽に教えてください。
cases.note: まだ関係が浅い相手には、責めずにまず相手を気づかい、待った時間と次の予定だけを短く伝える。
